payload.title: Module-access removal revokes no session and writes no audit row: RemoveModule only flips tenant_modules.isEnabled and removeUserFromModule and removeModuleManager only update rows, so live access tokens keep the module until expiry, while site-assignment changes already enqueue a durable token invalidation
evidence: apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/tenant-provisioning-command.service.ts:970-972 (the suspend path in the same service revokes user tokens; RemoveModule does not)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/tenant-admin.service.ts:412-413 (removeUserFromModule flips isActive with no invalidation and no audit)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/tenant-admin.service.ts:574-581 (site-assignment changes enqueue a durable token invalidation, the pattern module changes skip)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/tenant.service.ts:588 (Assign Manager records only a log line, no audit row)
payload.rule_violated: The RBAC-HIGH-001 rule recorded at tenant-user-management.service.ts:140-145 (a change to effective permissions must revoke live tokens) and the plan §7 timing cell (FORBIDDEN within one access-token TTL after revocation).
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-06, release R3.
